newsitem.title: UK: Rolls wins 25 mln stg Portuguese burner order.
newsitem.headline: Rolls wins 25 mln stg Portuguese burner order.

text.p: Rolls-Royce Plc said on Monday that its unit Rolls-Royce company International Combustion has won an order worth up to 25 million stg to supply environmentally-friendly burners to a Portuguese power station.
Rolls-Royce will convert up to four coal-fired boiler units, which they say will cut emissions of oxides of nitrogen by 58 percent at the Sines power plant.

It said that plant owner CPPE, Companhia Portuguesa de Producao de Electricidade, has ordered conversion of one unit with options on the other three. Work will start on the burners in the autumn and they will start operation in April next year.
